phases.input: Proven face/pose/hand-positive upper-body crop of the permitted full-body photo, letterboxed into 640×480. Feet are outside this crop; standing is a settings/workload label, not full-body tracking acceptance.

plan.singlePhaseBoundary: One phase only: this reproduces that workload with fresh browser state and does not constitute the full combined soak.
plan.delegate: default GPU; abort if actual initialization falls back to CPU
plan.recording: Existing Ene Landscape encoder/profile, uniquely owned recording directory; video-only source; existing silent audio track may remain.

failFast.action: Persist triggering timing/thumbnail, collect bounded paired canvas/OBS/native/GL evidence, stop this owned recording and restore; do not start the next phase.

plan.passiveBoundary: One main viewer in Clean mode; unchanged five-second timing and thirty-second memory samples. No extra rAF observer, periodic canvas/native/GL readbacks or activation. Small OBS-only thumbnails are an explicitly added observer.
plan.powerBoundary: Current power before and after the workload is retained. These endpoint observations do not prove continuous AC or browser Energy Saver state; no power/browser settings are changed.
plan.acceptanceBoundary: Positive still-fixture workload evidence only. No live movement, physical media, subjective quality, temperature sensors, thermal attribution or end-to-end latency acceptance.
